description: A high-performance API for Minecraft mods, built to handle tasks efficiently, reduce lag, use GPU acceleration, smart caching, and multithreading. Made with love :]

mods.name: Quantified API
mods.description: Next-gen performance API that aims to unlock the true potential of multithreading with ease. Built to handle insane workloads by utilizing modern hardware to its full extent, while bringing Vulkan-powered GPU acceleration with OpenCL as a fallback for maximum compatibility. License available at: https://github.com/Admany/Quantified-API/blob/master/LICENSE
